title: Tian mo
lead: {{Short description|Chinese breakfast soup}}'''Tian mo''' (甜沫) is a traditional breakfast soup from the city of [[Jinan]] in the [[Shandong]] province of [[China]]. The soup is made of [[millet]] powder, peanuts, [[vermicelli]], [[cowpea]], spiced [[tofu]] (or shredded tofu skin), and [[spinach]].<ref>{{Cite news|title=Have a bite of Jinan featured snacks |url=http://shandong.chinadaily.com.cn/2018-07/18/c_256430.htm |access-date=2024-02-16 |website=shandong.chinadaily.com.cn}}</ref> The soup has a thick texture once cooked and has a salty taste. It is normally eaten with [[youtiao]].{{Citation needed|date=October 2020}}
